occt-import-js 0.0.23
https://github.com/kovacsv/occt-import-js
Licence: GNU Lesser General Public License, version 2.1
See license.occt-import-js.txt and license.occt.txt in this folder.

occt-import-js.js and occt-import-js.wasm are the unmodified 0.0.23
distribution, except for one line added at the end of the JavaScript file:

    export default occtimportjs;

That line lets the browser load the file as an ES module. The WebAssembly
build is unchanged. Source for this version:
https://github.com/kovacsv/occt-import-js/releases/tag/0.0.23

Open CASCADE Technology, which the library binds, is available from
https://dev.opencascade.org/ and is covered by license.occt.txt.
